So `LZ4_createStream` calls `LZ4_initStream` which initializes the stream. Let me look at `LZ4_initStream`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>grep -n "LZ4_initStream\b" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/lib/lz4.c | head -5 && sed -n '1460,1500p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/lib/lz4.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
